Riverhead Capital Management LLC lowered its holdings in shares of Burlington (NYSE:BURL) by 36.3% in the 1st & Exchange 5,288 shares of the company’s stock after selling 3,012 shares during the quarter. Riverhead Capital Management LLC’s holdings in Burlington were worth $704,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also added to or reduced their stakes in BURL. Atria Investments LLC purchased a new stake in Burlington in the 4th quarter worth approximately $335,000. State of Alaska Department of Revenue purchased a new stake in Burlington in the 4th quarter worth approximately $565,000. Strs Ohio increased its holdings in Burlington by 97.6% in the 4th quarter. Strs Ohio now owns 207,500 shares of the company’s stock worth $25,528,000 after acquiring an additional 102,500 shares in the last quarter. James Investment Research Inc. purchased a new stake in Burlington in the 4th quarter worth approximately $2,128,000. Finally, Sumitomo Mitsui Asset Management Company LTD purchased a new stake in Burlington in the 4th quarter worth approximately $4,770,000.

Burlington opened at $136.23 on Thursday, MarketBeat reports. Burlington has a 1-year low of $79.07 and a 1-year high of $142.23. The company has a quick ratio of 0.31, a current ratio of 0.98 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 12.84. The company has a market capitalization of $9.31 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 31.17, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.26 and a beta of 0.42.
Burlington (NYSE:BURL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, March 8th. The company reported $2.17 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.09 by $0.08. Burlington had a negative return on equity of 754.89% and a net margin of 6.31%. The business had revenue of $1.94 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $1.89 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the company posted $1.78 EPS. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was up 14.9% compared to the same quarter last year. sell-side analysts expect that Burlington will post 5.78 EPS for the current fiscal year.
BURL has been the subject of several analyst reports. Credit Suisse Group initiated coverage on shares of Burlington in a report on Monday, March 12th. They issued an “outperform” rating and a $146.00 target price for the company. Buckingham Research reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $150.00 target price (up from $143.00) on shares of Burlington in a report on Friday, March 9th. Wolfe Research reissued an “outperform” rating and issued a $146.00 target price (up from $139.00) on shares of Burlington in a report on Friday, March 9th. Loop Capital initiated coverage on shares of Burlington in a report on Thursday, March 8th. They issued a “buy” rating and a $150.00 target price for the company. Finally, SunTrust Banks set a $145.00 target price on shares of Burlington and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Thursday, March 8th. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a hold rating and seventeen have assigned a buy rating to the company. The company presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $137.06.
In other news, CEO Thomas Kingsbury sold 20,000 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, April 10th. The stock was sold at an average price of $137.13, for a total transaction of $2,742,600.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the chief executive officer now directly owns 355,273 shares in the company, valued at approximately $48,718,586.49. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through this hyperlink. Also, insider Joyce Manning Magrini sold 2,500 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, May 1st. The shares were sold at an average price of $134.58, for a total value of $336,450.00. The disclosure for this sale can be found here. Insiders sold a total of 47,500 shares of company stock valued at $6,243,575 over the last 90 days. 1.91% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders.
About Burlington
Burlington Stores, Inc is an apparel and home product retailer. Its products include ladies sportswear, menswear, coats, family footwear and youth apparel, as well as baby furniture, accessories, home decor and gifts. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Burlington, NJ.
